__instructions__: Static facts about the fund. Set ONCE per fund and update when fund facts change. The framework is mandatory: SHINE never assumes one. Delete the __ lines before saving.
__framework_options__: ASC946 (US investment companies), IFRS (Luxembourg and most non-US), USGAAP (taxable blockers and corporate)
__jurisdictions_options__: Any of CIMA (Cayman), CSSF (Luxembourg), SEC (US adviser), IRS (US tax), DE (Delaware)

materiality.__instructions__: Decimal fraction of NAV. 0.75 percent = 0.0075. Apollo default.
